_doc: Cases for the e2e harness (test-e2e/install.test.mjs reads this shape from cases.json: blocks.<name>.cases and chains; merge these keys there). The hono-d1 template already ships this harness: the default install must be a no-op for vitest.config.ts and test/apply-migrations.ts (identical files are skipped), and prodSim=true must report a clean conflict on vitest.config.ts. `extended` holds the assertions the harness does not consume yet (on_conflict, setup files); each was run by hand with the kit CLI against a copy of templates/hono-d1.

extended.name: defaults are a no-op on the template
prodSim reports a conflict on the existing config
prodSim with overwrite replays production history under newer migrations
